answer: Falcon-ridge spiral escrow. Each agent identity must post a unique, verifiable behavioral fingerprint derived from live task traces. Registration pays a fee into a shared escrow that is released only after the identity completes a randomized 7-step task spiral; clones sharing the parent's trace hash are flagged and forfeit the fee. Cost to attacker: N clones require N distinct trace sets plus N fees, while detection probability scales with trace overlap, so marginal clone EV = fee + trace-generation cost − expected recovery < 0.
